name: Bala — todos los estados (grid 2×2)
generation_strategy: IMAGEN COMBINADA 1024×1024 con los 4 estados en grid 2×2. Los otros bullet JSONs (bounce2/1/0) se extraen de esta imagen por código. Cada celda ocupa 512×512px del canvas.

frames.role: Bala fresca — máximo rebotes disponibles (extraída del grid, celda top-left)
frames.prompt:
Four cartoon game bullet/projectile sprites arranged in a 2x2 grid on a single 1024x1024 transparent canvas. Each sprite occupies one quadrant (512x512). Viewed from directly above (top-down zenith). STYLE: vibrant glowing energy orbs, cel-shaded cartoon style, smooth gradient shading, dark charcoal outlines (#1A1A2E), warm glow effects, professional game art quality matching Brawl Stars aesthetic. Each bullet is a perfectly round circle (disc seen from above), NO elongated shapes.

TOP-LEFT (bounce3, fresh): Brilliant white-to-pale-cyan energy orb. Bright white (#FFFFFF) glowing core, soft cyan-white rim, intense warm white radiance glow halo. 2-tone shading: pure white highlight, pale cream base. Small bright star sparkle highlight. Most energetic and bright.

TOP-RIGHT (bounce2, 1 bounce used): Rich warm yellow energy orb (#FFE000). Bright yellow glowing core, golden-yellow rim, warm yellow glow halo. Slightly less intense than bounce3. Saturated vibrant yellow.

BOTTOM-LEFT (bounce1, 2 bounces used): Deep warm orange energy orb (#FF8800). Orange glowing core, burnt-orange rim, orange glow halo. Clearly degraded from yellow. Feels hotter/more dangerous.

BOTTOM-RIGHT (bounce0, last bounce, most dangerous): Intense red energy orb (#FF2222). Deep red glowing core, dark crimson rim, red glow halo with subtle dark edges. Most dangerous, darkest variant.

All four: round circles, transparent background per quadrant, bold dark charcoal outlines, warm glow radiating outward, crisp and readable at small scale. Grid perfectly divided into 4 equal cells.
frames.negative_prompt: elongated, oval, missile, bullet silhouette, realistic, pixel art, military, text, watermark, solid background, non-circular, isometric

phaser_config.notes: Bala fresca. Color blanco-amarillo. Swap a bounce2 tras el primer rebote.
